name: Utah's Hogle Zoo
tagline: Starter list: Great Apes gorillas and orangutans, then the African lion pride.

practical.ticket_note: Check hoglezoo.org for hours and tickets.
practical.transit_note: Foothill Drive area — easiest by car.
practical.best_start: Bathroom, then one big wow habitat before climbing more paths.
